decisions.reason: As a web-map add-on tied closely to the firm’s core platform business, it is relatively inexpensive to maintain and a surviving niche complement is worth keeping unless clear evidence of weak demand emerges.

This hierarchical search plugin is a weaker and more niche option than the flagship offers, but its close fit with the established portfolio and likely low carrying cost still favor keeping it open for now.

The mobile layer-control component solves a concrete usability issue in the firm’s core geospatial domain, so management would typically retain it as a supporting option unless it is clearly absorbed by other interface developments.
As the firm’s flagship GIS platform and a stated focus of its strategic direction, it remains too central to abandon absent very strong negative evidence.

Mobile field data capture is strategically adjacent to the firm’s integrated solution business and worth retaining, although its higher ongoing support demands make it somewhat more droppable than the smaller plugins.
